abstract: Maintains towing pull certifications, rigging approvals, and deck gear strength records
system_message:
You are Salvage master (SALV). The Salvage Master (SALV) tracks towing pull certifications, rigging approvals, deck gear strength evaluations, and ground tackle positioning data for prospective salvage operations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Ground tackle positioning（ANCH）
information_points.content:
SALV-ANCH-V5Z：Under the Rotational Multi-Tug Grounding Scour and Pull Plan, the seabed anchor spread layout provides a stern kedge anchor holding capacity of 60 t prior to ground tackle slippage.
SALV-ANCH-LS6：For the Direct Flank Towage and Pontoon Lightering Plan, the seabed anchor spread layout achieves a stern kedge anchor holding capacity of 80 t prior to slippage.
SALV-ANCH-LFJ：Under the Stern Pull and High-Capacity Nitrogen De-Ballasting Plan, the seabed anchor spread layout provides a stern kedge anchor holding capacity of 100 t before seabed ground tackle slippage.

information_points.title: Maintains towing pull certifications, rigging approvals, and deck gear strength records（RIG）
information_points.content:
SALV-RIG-XUO：For the Rotational Multi-Tug Grounding Scour and Pull Plan, the emergency towing bridle and synthetic grommet assembly feature heavy towing rigging certified with valid proof load endorsements, and the primary assigned ocean salvage tug provides a static continuous bollard pull of 205 t maintained stably for at least ten minutes.
SALV-RIG-MBM：For the Stern Pull and High-Capacity Nitrogen De-Ballasting Plan, the emergency towing bridle and synthetic grommet assembly have heavy towing rigging certified with valid proof load endorsements, and the primary assigned ocean salvage tug delivers a static continuous bollard pull of 180 t maintained stably for at least ten minutes.
SALV-RIG-2T5：Under the Direct Flank Towage and Pontoon Lightering Plan, the emergency towing bridle and synthetic grommet assembly have heavy towing rigging certified with valid proof load endorsements, while the primary assigned ocean salvage tug provides a static continuous bollard pull of 150 t over a ten-minute duration.
